name: Bright Dream Robotics Floor Tile Paving Robot R-19
summary: Wheeled robot that spreads tile adhesive and lays large-format floor tiles with a vacuum gripper, guided by laser navigation and four cameras.

germany.statusNote: No route for a German buyer. Bright Dream lists the robot only on its Chinese website, and its product page there is empty. BrightMaster Robotics (BMR), Bright Dream's global exclusive sales agent since March 2025, offers no tile robot. No EU office, dealer, customer or CE marking found. Partner Robotics, founded in 2023 by Bright Dream's former CEO with Bright Dream as shareholder, sells its own, different floor tile robot (see partner-robotics-pavepal-p900).

specs.label: Navigation
specs.value: laser navigation, visual recognition and an elevation positioning system

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: four-camera vision system for measuring and aligning tiles

specs.label: Tile gripper
specs.value: robot arm with vacuum grippers; picks up the tile and turns it 180 degrees

specs.label: Process
specs.value: spreads tile adhesive, carries tiles and lays them on the fresh adhesive bed

notes: No tile sizes, output, weight or battery data published.
The Red Dot photo shows the label 'Floor Tile Paving Robot BDR100-70' on the body; the maker's own picture shows 'BZL_CS03_A'.
Bright Dream also lists a separate outdoor (landscape) floor tile robot and a wall tile robot; this record covers the indoor floor tile robot only.

images.alt: Bright Dream floor tile paving robot: pink wheeled base with a lifting column and a vacuum tile gripper (render)

evidence.task: Lays floor tiles in housing, high-speed rail stations, airports, office buildings and schools
evidence.note: Maker says the robot is 'widely applied' in these settings; no named project.

evidence.task: Floor tile laying named by China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) as an excellent robot application scenario
evidence.note: From the timeline of BMR, Bright Dream's sales agent; model not named.
